content: MQL5 has no built-in unit test framework. Community solutions (MQLUnit, MTUnit) exist but require the Strategy Tester or external watcher tools and are lightly maintained. The pragmatic pattern (MQL5.com article 19154) is to separate pure, deterministic trading-math functions (no account/order/chart calls) into a standalone .mqh class, then drive it from a standalone Script (.mq5) with a lightweight assertion helper (.mqh) -- runs instantly in the MetaEditor without Strategy Tester or a live terminal.
